    The final round of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12, begins with early tee times around 9:00 a.m. ET, with the final pairing teeing off at 2:25 p.m. ET. Television coverage starts at 12:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and continues on CBS from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET. 
    • Final Round Tee Times: Play starts early in the morning (roughly 9 a.m.), with the last group teeing off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
    • Key Pairings (Approx. Times): Jon Rahm and Sergio Garcia are set for an earlier pairing, while leaders are in the final group.
    • TV Schedule: Coverage is available on CBS and Paramount+ starting in the early afternoon.
    • Watch Online: You can stream the action on CBSSports.com or the CBS Sports app. 
    Note: All times are subject to change based on scheduling and weather.
